# POSpire v1.1.2: Hotfix for the empty product grid, offline and returns

A hotfix release on top of v1.1.1. It fixes the empty product grid on newer ERPNext 16 and brings forward fixes for bugs found in v1.1.1. There are no new features. If you are coming from v1.1.0 or v1.1.1 there is nothing to do after upgrading. If you are coming from v1.0.x, read **Upgrading from v1.0.x** below first.

## What was fixed

- **Empty product grid on ERPNext 16.31 and later.** A POS Profile that lists item groups (or a user restricted to certain item groups) made the product list fail with a server error, so the grid stayed empty. Item group names are now quoted correctly, including names with spaces or apostrophes. Profiles with no item groups are unchanged.
- **Sales started offline could not be paid.** The paid total stayed at 0 and Submit was refused. These sales can now be paid and synced.
- **Offline tax could be too high.** When an item had a tax template, every account in that template was added as its own tax line, which overcharged carts on tax-exclusive profiles. The template now only changes the rates of the invoice's own taxes, the same way ERPNext does, and follows the "Add taxes from Item Tax Template" setting in Accounts Settings.
- **Partial returns with an invoice discount were blocked at PAY.** A return copied the whole Additional Discount of the sale. The discount is now shared out over the returned lines only.
- **Wrong company's item tax template.** When an item had tax templates for more than one company, the POS could pick another company's template, and PAY or Save and Clear failed with an account company error. The POS now uses only the template for the invoice's company.
- **Shift dialogs on small screens.** On short windows (common at 125 to 150% display scaling) the opening and closing shift dialogs now fill the window instead of sitting against the left edge.
- **Works on every ERPNext 16 release.** POSpire no longer needs a recent ERPNext 16 minor version to start, and v1.0.x sites on ERPNext 16.23 or later, where sales invoices could no longer be saved, work again after this update.
- **Private files on shared tills.** Images under `/private/files` are no longer kept in the browser's offline cache, so they do not stay on a shared till after a cashier logs out.
- **Offline closing index.** Sites upgraded from v1.0.x now get the database index that keeps offline shift closing fast.
- **App icon.** On Frappe 16.50 and later the POSpire icon opens the POSpire workspace again instead of going straight to the POS screen.

## Upgrading from v1.0.x

This release also brings everything from v1.1.0 and v1.1.1, including offline mode. A few things work differently after the update:

- **Offline mode is on.** Cashiers can keep selling when the network drops, and those sales are checked for stock and synced once the connection returns. To turn it off for the whole site, untick **Offline Enabled** in **POSpire Offline Settings**.
- **ERPNext's own Point of Sale is hidden.** The Point of Sale page and the POS Invoice, POS Opening Entry, POS Closing Entry, POS Invoice Merge Log and POS Settings screens are no longer shown in the desk. Existing records are kept.
- **Approval rules are checked.** An approval action that is set to Required now needs a PIN or remote approval it can use. Remote approval also needs **Enable Remote Approval** ticked on the POS Profile. Review these rules before the update, or the POS Profile may not save and the action may be blocked at the till.
- **Partial returns refund less discount.** A partial return now gives back only the share of the invoice discount that belongs to the returned items.
- **Reload open POS tabs** after the update so they pick up the new version.
